cards.card_text: Now God turns to blood: if anyone eats any blood, Israelite or foreigner, God says, "I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people." Friend, I got slid into a junk drawer and cut off from my whole family once, and I would NOT recommend it.
cards.verse_text: If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
